text:
Alex W: Quick status check on the optimize-kit delivery — specifically quant recommendations, batching/caching heuristics, and the regression-alert pipeline. Owners + blockers?
Maria L: I'm owning quant recommendations. PR is at https://github.com/redwood/optimize-kit/pull/412. Waiting on perf numbers from runtime for int8 on A100. cc @Kevin P
Kevin P: Running perf today. Early numbers: int8 reduces mem by ~3.8x but token latency +8% at short seq. Full table later. Also seeing a KV cache miss spike on tail requests.
Jen H: For batching/caching I'm on it. Deployed cache variant experiment to staging: config snippet:
```yaml
cache:
  type: prefix_kv
  ttl_sec: 60
  max_items: 20000
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  max_batch_size: 16
```
Alex W: Nice. Can you add the A/B gates so we can rollback quick if latency regresses? Need alerting tied to eval set.
ci-bot: regression-alert: eval-suite/latency increased by 12% on canary (model: llama-3-small, seq=512). link: https://ci.redwood/cases/874
Maria L: That CI alert matches the int8 perf run — seems related. I'll try quantizing with per-channel calibration instead of global.
Kevin P: I can repro locally with seq 512. Attaching logs (snippet):
```
2028-07-18 09:12:02 INFO decode_token latency=34.7ms kv_hits=0.12
2028-07-18 09:12:05 WARN cache_miss_spike recent=0.37
```
Jen H: Taking ownership of A/B gate + rollout policy. Plan: canary 5%, monitor p50/p95, auto-fallback to fp16 variant on +10% p95 spike. Target deploy today EOD.
Alex W: Outstanding blockers? infra quota/ Dedicated pools?
Kevin P: Need a quick kernel tweak in runtime to fix some f32 fallback path — will open issue and assign.
Maria L: I'll add a note in the PR about regression risk and recommended fallback config.
Jen H: I'll put the rollout plan in the console (route: optimize-kit/quant-experiment) and add dashboards.
Alex W: Perfect. Action items: Kevin opens runtime issue; Maria updates PR with fallback; Jen sets canary & dashboard; I'll ping sales for any customer-facing notes. If anything blocks EOD ping here. :thumbsup:
sre-ops: FYI added alert rule optimize-kit-latency-canary to PagerDuty (threshold: +10% p95 over baseline).
